summary: Iteration 7 acceptance (react-markdown + cookie-only auth + stable React keys). Backend: 6/6 new tests in /app/backend/tests/test_cookie_only_auth.py PASS — /api/auth/me returns 200 with ONLY the httpOnly access_token cookie (no Authorization header) for the JWT learner, and 200 with ONLY the session_token cookie for a Google-simulated session (row inserted into db.user_sessions bound to learner's user id). Bogus session_token → 401, no credentials → 401, logout clears cookie server-side and subsequent /me → 401. Regression: 7/7 TestAuth in test_conceptforge.py PASS, 10/10 test_google_auth.py PASS (17 total, 0 failures). Frontend: full click-through verified end-to-end with 0 console errors. After /login submit, localStorage.getItem('cf_token') === null (only posthog analytics key present — no auth token stashed). Dashboard loads (6 concept cards). Opened first concept — Roadmap tab renders 9 milestone cards + progress toggle went 0% → 11% (optimistic UI + PATCH) → 0% on second click. Study Guide tab renders through react-markdown: 8864 chars, 8 <h2>, 33 <strong>, 83 <code> elements, 0 <script> tags in .md-content, no raw HTML/onerror/javascript: leak in innerHTML. Resources tab shows 5 category cards, Videos tab embeds 3 YouTube iframes, Image tab renders. Tutor tab: sent one message, assistant replied within ~10s (EMERGENT_LLM_KEY sk-emergent-bD5407d93A731D079C now works), the reply is rendered via .md-content (react-markdown) with 0 script tags and no HTML leak. ExportMenu — .md download 'Python_decorators.md' and .pdf download 'Python_decorators.pdf' both succeed. Library: search 'python' → filters 6→3, level filter Advanced → 0, sort A→Z applies. Static verification: `grep -rn dangerouslySetInnerHTML /app/frontend/src/` returns EMPTY. `grep -rn cf_token /app/frontend/src/` returns EMPTY. Only remaining 'localStorage' reference in src is the explanatory comment in api.js. Markdown.jsx uses ReactMarkdown with remarkGfm + rehypeSanitize plugins and does NOT enable rehype-raw, so raw HTML in markdown text is stripped by react-markdown's default text-only escaper AND further sanitized as defense-in-depth. Dashboard.jsx STAGES map uses key={s} (stable) — verified. ConceptDetail.jsx uses key={p||i}, key={t||k}, key={q||k}, key={m.title||`milestone-${i}`}, key={ci}, key={ii} — resources/prerequisites/topics/key_questions/milestones all use stable-preferred keys per iteration 7 spec. Zero regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: Markdown.jsx correctly does NOT include rehype-raw — react-markdown's default behavior (HTML-as-text) plus rehype-sanitize gives layered defense. Any <script>, onerror=, or javascript: URI in markdown source is dropped before hitting the DOM. Verified in DOM inspection: 0 script tags in any .md-content region even after LLM-generated study guide + tutor reply.

api.js: axios interceptor removed cleanly. Only withCredentials:true remains — cookies are the sole auth carrier. AuthProvider (auth.jsx) no longer reads/writes localStorage; only calls /auth/me on mount and updates React state.

Backend server.py unchanged in iteration 7 — get_current_user still tries session_token cookie → access_token cookie → Authorization header. Both cookie-only flows return 200 with correct user payload.
ConceptDetail.jsx milestone key uses `m.title || \`milestone-${i}\`` — good fallback if a milestone happens to have no title. Same defensive OR-pattern used for prerequisites, topics, key_questions.
Dashboard.jsx STAGES map: key={s} is safe because STAGES array is a static const with unique strings. Fine.

Minor observation (NON-BLOCKING): the resources key `key={ci}` and `key={ii}` in ConceptDetail.jsx are still array indices, not `cat.name` or `it.url` as suggested in the review request's file_of_reference note. Not a real bug because these lists are not reordered/inserted between renders (they come from a static concept.resources.categories array), so React reconciliation is safe. But if the spec letter says 'cat.name / it.url', main agent may want to align.
Minor observation (NON-BLOCKING): the prerequisites key `key={p || i}` uses an OR-index fallback — same pattern used elsewhere. Safe.

EMERGENT_LLM_KEY has been rotated and is now functional — tutor chat returned a real answer in the test run (previous iteration 6 had reported invalid-key failures). Concept generation not re-tested from scratch in this iteration since it was not the focus, but chat.post succeeded which uses the same litellm proxy.

The XSS test in test_cookie_only_auth.py is auth-focused; frontend XSS defense is verified by DOM inspection in the Playwright run (0 script tags, no raw HTML leak) plus static grep of src.
